name: revenue-handler-untested
title: revenue-critical handler that no test imports
detail: A payment-provider / order / cart / checkout / refund / payment-webhook handler that no test or spec file anywhere in the repo imports — the exact 'only the tested path works' gap. Untested revenue paths ship silent money bugs (wrong charge, double charge, missing confirmation email, unhandled alternate provider).
fix: add an integration/e2e test that imports this module and exercises its happy path plus at least one edge path (alternate provider, failure, retry/idempotency).
